title: Cloud Infrastructure Operations
description: Alert triage for IT operations: seven fictional monitoring alerts, a transparent priority P1 to P3, a guardrail against injected instructions, and a button that runs the same triage as an n8n workflow through the chat.
insights: Fictional alerts and fixed rules: priority points come from severity, business impact, customer facing and repeats, and every alert shows its reasons.

The page calculates the triage itself (preview). 'Run in n8n' asks the chat to start the n8n workflow 04-it-operations-alert-triage through the connector tool run_it_ops_triage; a Space has no network of its own.
Alert text is untrusted: an alert that tells an AI assistant what to do is quarantined and never passed on. Nothing is paged, restarted or changed; a person decides.
prompt: Bundled example: Cloud Infrastructure Operations (static, alerts embedded by npm run sync:it-operations).
